outputs.head: Commit
outputs.author: Author
outputs.subject: Subject
outputs.stale: Remote moved since the last fetch

repository.label: Repository
repository.description: A folder resource. Empty: the project's repository resource.

projectId.label: Project
projectId.description: Whose repository, when no repository is set. Empty: the workflow's current project. Choosing one never changes the active project.

limit.label: Files listed
limit.description: At most this many paths in the list.

refresh.label: Ask the remote
refresh.description: Off: what was last fetched, without the network. On: also asks the remote for its branch (git ls-remote), which changes nothing locally.

application.label: Open with
application.description: An application resource such as an editor. Empty: the file manager.

status.name: Repository status
status.description: Branch, whether the work tree is clean, counts of changes and how far the branch is ahead of or behind its upstream as last fetched. Local only.

branch.name: Current branch
branch.description: The checked-out branch and commit; reports a detached HEAD and a branch without commits. Local only.

changes.name: Changed files
changes.description: The paths with changes, one per line with their status (as `git status --short`), and counts. Local only.

last-commit.name: Last commit
last-commit.description: The commit HEAD points to: hash, author name, date and subject. Local only.

remote-status.name: Remote status
remote-status.description: How the branch compares with its upstream: ahead and behind as last fetched, and on request whether the remote has moved since.

open-repository.name: Open repository
open-repository.description: Opens the repository folder in the file manager or an application.

plugin.name: Git
plugin.description: Status, branch, changes, last commit and remote state of project repositories. Never changes a repository.

dependencies.projects: Without a repository parameter the actions use the repository resource of the workflow's project; without Projects there is no project, and only keys with a repository work.

permissions.tools: Runs your own git in the repository folders you bound, to read their status, branch, last commit and remote state: git status, log -1, config --get of the branch's remote and merge, remote, rev-parse. Never changes a repository. Remote status with Ask the remote also runs git ls-remote, which uses your SSH identity and git credential helpers to contact the remotes your repository configures.
permissions.resources: Uses the repository folders and applications you bound on this computer; reports the folder's path as the Repository folder output, and opens it in the file manager or the application you chose when you press Open repository.
permissions.profile: Reads the active project's key to report which project a repository belongs to.
permissions.device: Shows the branch, and whether the work tree is clean, on Repository status and Current branch keys, as their last run found it.

repositoryRole.label: Repository resource
repositoryRole.description: The project resource used when an action names no repository.

networkTimeoutSeconds.label: Network time limit (s)
networkTimeoutSeconds.description: For refreshing the remote state. DeckPilot's own limit for git's network use still applies.

errors.not-found: The repository folder does not exist.
errors.not-a-repository: The folder is not a Git repository.
errors.unsafe-repository: Git refuses the repository because another user owns it (safe.directory).
errors.git-not-found: Git was not found on this computer.
errors.project-not-in-profile: The project does not belong to this profile.
errors.no-commits: The branch has no commits yet.
errors.no-remote: The upstream's remote is not configured.
errors.resource-unbound: The resource is not bound on this computer.
errors.resource-role-missing: The project does not define the repository resource.
errors.resource-kind-mismatch: The resource is not a folder (or, for Open with, an application).
errors.resource-missing: The resource does not exist in this profile.
errors.not-user-initiated: Opening is allowed only in runs you started.
